coveRumor0.text: Haspids are the most powerful creature of the Coves.

coveRumor1.text: I've heard the residents of the Cove will light a Lodestar to honor any hero who brings them the Grail.

coveRumor2.text: It is said the Nymphs can move through any obstacles.

coveRumor3.text: Ice spells can do no harm to the Oceanids.

coveRumor4.text: Corsair is not the end of what a true pirate can achieve!

coveRumor5.text: Sea Dogs are accurate shooters. They can slay even a Dragon with one shot.

coveRumor6.text: Ayssids are dangerous creatures. Once they feel the taste of blood, they cannot stop.

coveRumor7.text: Sorceresses often cast weakening spells in battle.

coveRumor9.text: It is said gravely wounded Haspids can be extremely dangerous.

coveRumor10.text: One pirate was trying to convince me that he knows a formula of a secret powder that allows giant cannon balls to fly up from a single spark!

coveRumor11.text: They say that the Thieves Guild is cooperating with the pirates.

coveRumor12.text: They say that the lodestars are seen best from the maritime cities.

coveRumor13.text: They say that Sea Serpents have awakened from the depths and emerged on the lands. They crush everything in their way.

coveRumor14.text: Black-sailed ships are being traded in the shore-side Coves.

coveRumor15.text: Deep in the seas, on the very bottom, a mysterious Horn lies still. It will give you unmatched power.
